_about: What Word 16.106 drew for tools/make_revision_probe.py in its No Markup view: every text object and filled rectangle (as render-observations.json records them), each case's lines as Word drew them (page and baseline from the case's label, left edge, glyphs), the cases whose lines differ once every revision is accepted, the renderer's scores against them -- cases per family, lines within half a pixel, the glyph row, the rule pixels -- and every face number the renderer asked for. Measurements only; regenerate with tools/read_revision_probe.py --record.
